Type: shelf
Name: Pinzon Hayes Shelf
Colors: Tiki
Materials: wood
Beautifully crafted shelving unit offers 2 drawers to maximize efficiency Solid birch construction with basswood veneer; brushed stainless steel handles Open front and sides for easy accessibility; easy assembly; holds up to 100 pounds Coordinates with the Pinzon Hayes Office Furniture Collection; tiki brown finish Measures 30 inches wide by 14 inches deep by 64-1/2 inches high
